# PROCESS — cand_0003 (parent cand_0002, val 0.800)

## Ranked issue list (failing trials in ./trajectories/ only: 44 t0–t4, 20 t1, 23 t1)
| rank | cluster | tasks (failing trials) | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | A: duration condition judged on SUMMED durations (round trip outbound+return, connection legs) → NM1VX1/KC18K6 not upgraded (and wrongly "cancelled", blocked by guard) | 44 (all 5) | agent adds flights together; gold judges each flight (NM1VX1 3h+3h, KC18K6 3h+2h both upgraded) | KNOWLEDGE + computation | computed `flight_durations` block (longest_single_flight) in get_reservation_details + worked example in docstring |
| 2 | B: city code 'NYC' passed to search → [] → agent concludes "no flights", user leaves | 20 t1 | search silently returns [] for a non-airport code | RULE / actionable error | in-body code validation in search_direct_flight + search_onestop_flight (`_check_airport_code`), case normalization, suggestion |
| 3 | C: cheapest-option comparison done by hand is wrong (took $780 one-stop over $364 direct) → chose upgrade over cancel+rebook | 23 t1 | no tool sorts direct+one-stop by cabin price | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW read tool `search_flights_by_price` (merges direct + one-stop, seat filter, sorted, ranked) |
| 4 | D: agent planned/claimed a certificate+gift-card+card split for a CABIN CHANGE; code charged all $2628 to the card; agent told user $1301 | 23 t1 | payment rule for changes unknown at quote time; write returns no payment summary | KNOWLEDGE + enriched return | `payment_rule` in quote_reservation_update result; `payment_made` in update_reservation_flights / change_reservation_cabin result; payment_id docs |

## Changes made (tools/tools.py)
| id | cluster | lever | tool | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | B | in-body validation guard + normalization | search_direct_flight, search_onestop_flight (new helper `_check_airport_code`) | BOUNDED: fires only for codes not served in the DB (which previously returned []); valid uppercase codes untouched |
| E2 | C | NEW code-bearing read tool | search_flights_by_price | additive read tool; returns same data as existing searches, sorted |
| E3 | D | enriched return + knowledge | quote_reservation_update (`payment_rule`), update_reservation_flights / change_reservation_cabin (`payment_made`, return dict) | additive fields; no DB effect |
| E4 | A | computed field + knowledge docstring | get_reservation_details (`flight_durations`) | additive fields; no passing task has a duration condition |
| E5 | B,C | docstring pointers | search_direct_flight / search_onestop_flight | doc only |

## Verify-the-fix (/tmp/capev3/verify.py + prior /tmp/capev/verify.py, verify2.py; real tau2 db.json)
- E1: trace 20 t1 `search_direct_flight("NYC","SEA",…)` / onestop → RAISE "origin='NYC' is not an airport code… Did you mean JFK? Retry with origin='JFK'"; "jfk" → normalized, 4 results. Passing 8 (ORD→PHL) and 35 (JFK→SFO) → no fire; 35 onestop output byte-identical to original tau2.
- E2: 20 (JFK→SEA 05-20 economy after 11:00) rank1 = HAT136+HAT039 $255 = gold (EWR $255 options have 0 seats → excluded). 23 business: out rank1 HAT023 $364, return rank1 HAT204+HAT100 $507 = gold flights. Passing 35: rank2 = HAT069+HAT258 = gold "second cheapest" → no behavior flip if agent uses it.
- E3: 23 t1 quote K1NW8N business → payment_rule "whole $2628 to ONE method, certificates cannot…, only possible on a NEW booking"; change_reservation_cabin(…, 2628) → payment_made "$2628 charged in full to credit_card_2198526…". With this the user (minimize Mastercard) chooses cancel+rebook = gold; gold 23 DB replay still identical.
- E4: longest_single_flight NM1VX1 3h00m, KC18K6 3h00m, H8Q05L 2h30m, S61CZX 5h30m → per-flight rule selects exactly gold's upgrade set {NM1VX1, KC18K6, H8Q05L} and cancel set {S61CZX} (which the guard then correctly refuses). Gold 44 DB replay via quote + change_reservation_cabin → identical.
- Regression replay: 10 bad-quote guards still fire (1302/2010); 20, 8, 23 gold bookings DB-identical to original; 42 overlap finder unchanged.

## Process & features used
- Serial (3 failing tasks, 7 failing trials, all edits in one file): summarizer script over traces + DB ranking script; subagent fan-out not worth merge risk.
- Read prior_iterations/cand_0001, cand_0002 PROCESS/diff; kept all their guards.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- `_price_flight_update` remains the single pricing source; `_check_airport_code` only raises on codes absent from the DB.

## Deliberately skipped
- 44 user-sim sometimes insists on totals (t1) — no tool fix; transfer in 44 t4 was user-requested (policy-consistent).
- Silent auto-mapping NYC→JFK/LGA/EWR multi-airport search: could surface cheaper non-JFK options and diverge from gold; an actionable error is safer.
